lms_z <- function(x, L, M, S) ifelse(L != 0, ((x / M)^L - 1) / (L * S), log(x / M) / S)

statage <- read.csv("https://www.cdc.gov/growthcharts/data/zscore/statage.csv")
names(statage) <- tolower(names(statage))

data_dir <- "data"
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
base_url <- "https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles"
for (f in c("DEMO_J", "BMX_J", "DXX_J")) {
  dest <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(f, ".xpt"))
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    download.file(file.path(base_url, paste0(f, ".xpt")), dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  }
  if (!grepl("HEADER RECORD", readChar(dest, 40))) {
    stop(sprintf("%s is not a SAS transport file (got an HTML/error page). Check the URL.", f))
  }
}

read_module <- function(name) as.data.frame(read_xpt(file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, ".xpt"))))
demo <- read_module("DEMO_J")
bmx <- read_module("BMX_J")
dxx <- read_module("DXX_J")
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(demo$SEQN)), !any(duplicated(bmx$SEQN)), !any(duplicated(dxx$SEQN)))

df <- demo[, c("SEQN", "RIAGENDR", "RIDEXAGM", "WTMEC2YR", "SDMVSTRA", "SDMVPSU", "INDFMPIR")]
df <- merge(df, bmx[, c("SEQN", "BMXHT")], by = "SEQN", all.x = TRUE)
df <- merge(df, dxx[, c("SEQN", "DXDSTBMD")], by = "SEQN", all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(df) == nrow(demo))

names(df)[names(df) == "RIAGENDR"] <- "sex"
names(df)[names(df) == "BMXHT"] <- "height_cm"
names(df)[names(df) == "DXDSTBMD"] <- "tblh_bmd"
df$age_band <- floor(df$RIDEXAGM / 12)
df$in_cohort <- !is.na(df$age_band) & df$age_band >= 8 & df$age_band <= 19 &
  !is.na(df$RIDEXAGM) & !is.na(df$height_cm) & !is.na(df$tblh_bmd)

agemos <- df$RIDEXAGM + 0.5
df$haz <- NA_real_
for (s in c(1, 2)) {
  m <- !is.na(df$sex) & df$sex == s
  ref <- statage[statage$sex == s, ]
  ref <- ref[order(ref$agemos), ]
  L <- approx(ref$agemos, ref$l, agemos[m], rule = 2)$y
  M <- approx(ref$agemos, ref$m, agemos[m], rule = 2)$y
  S <- approx(ref$agemos, ref$s, agemos[m], rule = 2)$y
  df$haz[m] <- lms_z(df$height_cm[m], L, M, S)
}

df <- merge(df, tblh_coefs, by = c("sex", "age_band"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
df <- merge(df, tblh_lms, by = c("sex", "age_band"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
df$predicted_z <- df$intercept + df$slope * df$haz
df$observed_z <- lms_z(df$tblh_bmd, df$L, df$M, df$S)
df$adjusted_z <- df$observed_z - df$predicted_z
df[!df$in_cohort, c("haz", "predicted_z", "observed_z", "adjusted_z")] <- NA

a <- df[df$in_cohort, ]
cat(sprintf("eligible children 8-19 with height + exam-age + valid TBLH BMD: %d\n\n", nrow(a)))
cat("UNWEIGHTED race-neutral HAZ-adjusted TBLH BMD z:\n")
cat(sprintf("  mean %.4f  sd %.4f  min %.4f  max %.4f\n",
            mean(a$adjusted_z), sd(a$adjusted_z), min(a$adjusted_z), max(a$adjusted_z)))
n_low <- sum(a$adjusted_z <= -2)
cat(sprintf("  z <= -2: %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n\n", n_low, nrow(a), 100 * n_low / nrow(a)))

df$low <- as.numeric(df$adjusted_z <= -2)
des <- svydesign(ids = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~WTMEC2YR, data = df, nest = TRUE)
sub <- subset(des, in_cohort)
wm <- svymean(~adjusted_z, sub)
wp <- svymean(~low, sub)
cat("SURVEY-WEIGHTED (national) via NHANES MEC design:\n")
cat(sprintf("  mean adjusted z: %.4f (SE %.4f)\n", coef(wm)[[1]], SE(wm)[[1]]))
cat(sprintf("  prevalence z <= -2: %.1f%% (SE %.1f pp)\n", 100 * coef(wp)[[1]], 100 * SE(wp)[[1]]))

## CHECKING TO SEE IF THE BMD Z-SCORE IS NOW CALCULATED CORRECTLY IN THIS FILE 
## RUNNING THE SAME MODEL THAT WAS CHECKED IN P4. 
# this model is unweighted and not using dummy variables
fpl_model <- df |> lm(formula = adjusted_z~INDFMPIR)

summary(fpl_model)

### checking with categories
#create new var for FPL categories
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    fpl_cat = case_when(
      INDFMPIR < 1.00 ~ "Poverty (< 100% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 1.00 & INDFMPIR <= 1.30 ~ "Near Poverty (100-130% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 1.31 & INDFMPIR < 2.00 ~ "Low-Middle Income (131-199% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR >= 2.00 & INDFMPIR <= 3.50 ~ "High-Middle Income (200-350% PIR)",
      INDFMPIR > 3.50 ~ "High Income (> 350% PIR)",
      .default = NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Poverty (< 100% PIR)", "Near Poverty (100-130% PIR)", "Low-Middle Income (131-199% PIR)", "High-Middle Income (200-350% PIR)", "High Income (> 350% PIR)")))

## model
fpl_cat_model <- df |> lm(formula = adjusted_z~fpl_cat)

summary(fpl_cat_model)
